content.text: Lets re-structure the teaser page. I want the following animation: when I scroll in a car card, I want the museum photo/3D model view to stay on the screen once I scroll till that. After that, if I scroll further, only the right stretch should be scrolled so that the animation control, the labels and then the background information is all present alongside the photo/3D model, all controlled by scroll.
I'll start by reading how the teaser page is built today.

content.text:
On the teaser, each car's photo/3D view now stays pinned on screen while only the column beside it scrolls, and the scroll position decides what the view shows. Unit tests (149) and the full e2e suite (149 on iPhone/iPad × 4 plus Chromium offline) pass. I haven't checked it on a real iPhone or iPad, and nothing is committed.

**How each car scrolls.** Once you reach a car, its view pins: beside the text on iPad, desktop and phones held sideways, at the top on a phone held upright. Then only the right-hand column moves, in steps:
1. **Intro:** the car's title and lede, with the museum photo and the first mechanism drawn into it.
2. **One step per mechanism:** its controls, its colour legend ("labels"), then "What to say at the car". The view switches to that mechanism in 3D.
3. **Background:** the car's note, the "not verified" list, sources and a link to the full stop page. The view returns to the museum photo with the car outline.

Whichever step is at the middle of the free screen space drives the view; the other steps are dimmed. When the car's section ends, the view scrolls away with it. I read "labels" as the colour legends and parts lists; if you meant something else, the steps are easy to rearrange.

**Code changes**
- The 3D part of a stop moved out of `shell.js` into a new shared `lib/app/viewer.js`, so the stop page and the teaser use the same code. The stop page behaves as before.
- New `lib/app/teaser.js` builds the scroll page and runs the scroll logic. The teaser branch in `index.js` is gone.
- Only views that are on screen animate; the stage got a `stop()` for this. That matters because the teaser now holds three 3D scenes, one of them the live wind tunnel.
- Control ids now include the car's name, because all three cars have an "engine" and their ids would otherwise clash on one page.
- Smaller tidy-ups: one shared DOM helper (`lib/app/dom.js`), and the offline status line is now shared between the two route pages.
- The hero text now says to scroll instead of "open a car". Hungarian is updated, plus three new lines.

**Tests added**
- One per device that scrolls every step of every car. It checks the right mechanism and view are shown, the view stays put through the mechanism steps, only the visible car animates, and there's no sideways scroll.
- A Hungarian pass of the teaser.

**Not covered by the tests**
- Three 3D scenes on one page could strain memory and battery on an older iPhone. Only one runs at a time, but please try it on a device, including Low Power Mode.
- As on the stop pages, dragging on the pinned view turns the model rather than scrolling the page. On a phone held upright you scroll by dragging the text below it.

The dev server is still running if you want to try it: http://localhost:8765/teaser.html
